description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'UpdateFlagsRequest' used for updating email flags such as read, starred, archived, and deleted status in an email backend system. It includes getter and setter methods and Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: UpdateFlagsRequest
classes.description: A DTO class for encapsulating email flag update actions, with fields for read, starred, archived, and deleted statuses.

methods.name: getRead
methods.description: Returns the current read status of the email.

methods.name: getStarred
methods.description: Returns whether the email is starred.

methods.name: getArchived
methods.description: Returns whether the email is archived.

methods.name: getDeleted
methods.description: Returns whether the email is marked for deletion.

methods.name: setRead
methods.description: Sets the read status of the email.

methods.name: setStarred
methods.description: Sets the starred status of the email.

methods.name: setArchived
methods.description: Sets the archived status of the email.

methods.name: setDeleted
methods.description: Sets the deleted status of the email.
